title: Which driver will win the 2026 Formula One Spanish Grand Prix?
background: The Spanish Grand Prix is a round of the Formula One World Championship.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official race classification published by the FIA or Formula One. 
  Resolution : Resolve to the driver classified as the winner of the 2026 Spanish Grand Prix, scheduled for September 13, 2026. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The driver's name.
